raw_segments.text: At that preluding moment, ere the boat was yet snapped, Ahab, the first to perceive the
whale's intent by the crafty appraising of his head, a movement that loosed his hold
At that moment his hand had made one final effort to push the boat out of the bite.
But only slipping further into the whale's mouth, and tilting over sideways as it slipped,
the boat had shaken off his hold on the jaw, spilled him out of it as he leaned to the
bush, and so he fell flat-faced upon the sea.
